description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Transmission Shift Lever Repair Kit that repairs all the shifting components of the Transmission Shift Lever.
This Repair kit fits Samurai from 1985 -1989
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cover, Lever Case
Qty 3 – Bolts, Cover
Qty 1 – Washer, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Bush, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Boot #2, Shift Lever
Qty 1 – Locating Bolt, 10mm
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1989 All Models
